title: Adopt ctl-meta current-read and resource-safety provider without downstream fork
purpose: Record downstream adoption of ctl-meta current-read and resource-safety dogfood tooling as the canonical reader for CTL current-state and resource-safety queries, while keeping twisted-yetter's local ctl_store.py as a thin adapter rather than a fork.
claim_boundary: This note records tooling and provider-policy adoption only. It does not assert a new twisted-yetter mathematical result, does not change ctl-kernel/1 semantics, and does not import ctl-meta's project-local normative CTL state.

adoption_boundary.adoption_type: downstream provider adoption of CTL current-read tooling

upstream_provider.author: jcguu95 <jcguu95@gmail.com>
upstream_provider.subject: Deduplicate compact resource notices
new_compact_notice_features: search-current --compact deduplicates resource_notices by selected safety overlay, then resource identity, then snapshot identity, then lookup surface
compact resource_notices retain aggregate lookup_keys, lookup_selectors, detection_modes, matched_logical_ids, resource_ids, snapshot_ids, selected_overlay_logical_id, and selected_overlay_cid
fuzzy dedupe, downstream-specific logic, hard blocking, lookup-resource semantic changes, and NLP/ranking remain rejected upstream

downstream_adapter.policy: Delegate to ctl-meta/meta/ctl-dogfood/scripts/ctl_store.py, normalize repo-local absolute --path arguments to repo-relative paths, and inject --store-root for the twisted-yetter ctl-dogfood store when the caller did not provide one.
non_fork_checks: adapter preserves path_hygiene_report as a subprocess-backed compatibility API for existing downstream tests
adapter path normalization is CLI ergonomics only and does not reimplement CTL current-read or resource-safety logic

current_read_discipline.compact_search_summary: search-current --compact returns current_objects and deduplicated resource_notices instead of the full matches payload. It preserves ResourceSafetyStatus top_notice values for daily use, deduplicates notices by selected overlay/resource/snapshot identity without fuzzy merging, and keeps full search-current available for detailed inspection.
current_read_discipline.generated_index_summary: A fresh generated/current-index.json is a non-canonical acceleration of the replayed current root. It may serve lookup-current, search-current, and lookup-resource results with source_state generated-non-canonical-current-view; stale or missing index output must be refreshed with build-current-index or treated as a slow canonical fallback, not as an alternate source of truth.
current_read_discipline.discipline_summary: Current-state and resource-safety answers must be grounded in replayed CTL current root, active bindings, ResourceSafetyStatus overlays, or a fresh generated current index built from that root. Filesystem search is acceptable for discovery or archaeology, not as the final current-state source.
current_read_discipline.resource_safety_registration_policy: Reusable evaluators, scripts, generated artifacts, and lab notes that become known-wrong, deprecated, superseded, or replacement-critical should be registered as ctl-resource handle/snapshot/safety-status claims rather than relying only on file headers or prose notes.

This update edits the provider-adoption preimage, refreshes the current-read compact-search regression test for deduplicated ResourceSafetyStatus notices, and rebuilds generated/current-index.json after admission.

source_of_truth_policy: This is a machine-readable CTL lab-note preimage. The admitted claim for this payload is the current provider-adoption record.
